# Cohort 126: remaining measured continuation constructors

The two named fixtures move PostgreSQL construction to the existing native owner
at the exact former opening point. No SQL, delegate, source or execution policy
changes. Finite complete-function recipes preserve every other statement, with
actual-source checks and hostile owner/backend/workload/assertion controls.

Scenario mailbox proof preserves the real HTTP selector and more than 200
canonical domain-created cards, late exact identity/hash and cross-page ambiguity.
It is not source-authored creation, serve boot or decision mutation end-to-end.

Selected-process admission retains refusal before bind and reconciliation, foreign
process exclusion, exact process possession/release, every crossed capability
axis, cancellation and successor currency. Both stores run the original root
under race. This is native construction confinement, not production admission
redesign or parent closure. Other shared raw fixtures remain migration debt.
